title: Ceiling on the Protection Fee for One Trip, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The ceiling on the protection fee for one trip under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan follows the length of
the reservation, counted in whole months of the reserved period on the Keyturn Trip Booking beneath the
election.

**Where the reserved period runs for 2 or more whole months**, the ceiling is 3200.00 USD.

**Where it runs for 1 or more whole months but fewer than 2**, the ceiling is 2400.00 USD.

**Where it runs for fewer than 1 whole month**, the ceiling is 1200.00 USD.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Whole months the reserved period runs for | Ceiling on the fee |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1200.00 USD |
| 1 | 2400.00 USD |
| 2 | 3200.00 USD |
| 7 | 3200.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical reservations

A trip reserved from the second of April to the twenty-second of April runs for no whole month and is held to
1200.00 USD. A trip reserved from the second of April to the tenth of May runs for one whole month and is held
to 2400.00 USD. A trip reserved from the second of April to the ninth of June runs for two whole months and is
held to 3200.00 USD, and so is a trip reserved through to the end of October.

Where the fee falls below the ceiling that the reservation carries, the ceiling does not touch it: a fee of
900.00 USD on a trip of no whole month stands at 900.00 USD, while a fee of 1500.00 USD on the same trip stands
at 1200.00 USD.
